d: A lifelong American Chopper fan gets the opportunity of a lifetime when the OCC crew turns his dream motorcycle into reality. Joseph McClendon works alongside Paul Sr., Paul Jr. and the team to bring his personal vision to life through custom designs, fabrication and incredible finishing details. Watch the FANtasy Bike go from sketches to a stunning custom chopper in American Chopper Season 3 Episode 64 only on discovery+ India.
